## Teaching philosophy

I believe the goal of mathematical education is not to produce students
who can execute procedures, but students who can *think* — who can sit
with a problem they have never seen before and find a way in. In
practice, this means I spend a lot of time asking questions rather than
giving answers, and encouraging students to articulate why a method works
rather than just that it works.

I am always happy to hear from students looking for support.
Feel free to [get in touch](about.qmd).
